label: Water cruet
museum: National Museum in Warsaw (Muzeum Narodowe w Warszawie)
object_description: Late Gothic silver-gilt water cruet used at Roman Catholic Mass; museum title in Polish is Późnogotycki ampułka mszalna do wody.
rights_evidence: The exact Wikimedia Commons File page explicitly names Catholic water cruet and licenses the original photograph CC0; not inferred from date of historic metalwork.
caveat: Rare circa-1500 Gothic goldsmithery is not a typical ordinary 1962 glass water cruet. Suitable as historically authentic EQ02 example with explicit period label; may not be primary ordinary typology if representative modern vessel required.
